main_body: steampunk factory building with corrugated metal roof and brick facade
top_band: grey corrugated metal roof slope with skylights and top ridge from row 48 to 90, followed by orange/brown cornice at rows 91-93
evidence: The building shows a large foreshortened sloped metal roof (rows 48-90) with a chimney having an elliptical top opening (rows 1-4), a bright orange front cornice edge (rows 91-93) with shadow beneath, and a recessed brick south wall (rows 94-126) with inset doors and windows.

style.evidence: The building features 5+ shading steps across the corrugated metal roof, brickwork, and brass fixtures. Outlines use dark material tones, and surfaces have rich texture including rust speckles, individual bricks, and window reflections matching the reference density.
